FN-WKGJ999-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 152
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/20/2025
House Bill 152 as introduced would reduce sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an
estimated $10.5 million annually, for Fiscal Years 2026 through Fiscal Year 2030, by exempting
the gross proceeds of the sale of certain baby supplies, baby formula, maternity clothing, and
menstrual hygiene products from state sales and use tax.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to local goverments by a cumulative
estimated maximum of $14.4 million annually, if all local governments adopted the exemption
provided by this bill.

FN-WKGJ999-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 152
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/02/2025
House Bill 152 as passed the House of Representatives would reduce sales tax receipts to the
Education Trust Fund by an estimated $13 million annually, for Fiscal Years 2026 through
Fiscal Year 2030, by exempting the gross proceeds of the sale of certain baby supplies, baby
formula, maternity clothing, diapers, and menstrual hygiene products from state sales and use
tax.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to local governments by a cumulative
estimated maximum of $17.6 million annually, if all local governments adopted the exemption
provided by this bill.
